title: Magical, Supernatural & Multiversal Overlay Library
library_rules: All ENV-13 overlays use the ENV-04 typed-delta, effect-key and explicit-relation resolver contract.
No universal damage, saving throw, mutation, alignment, possession, spell bonus, spell failure, technology failure, time-conversion, exposure, sanity or corruption formula is authored here.

Characters, creatures and NPCs are evaluated by participant-owning systems; spells and abilities are evaluated by ability systems; devices and vehicles are evaluated by technology systems after the environment projection is resolved.
Interaction is not causation: an amplifies, dampens or transforms_with edge only applies when both referenced overlays are already active in materially overlapping scopes.
World, Reality, Branch, Place and portal endpoint identity are not environment overlays and remain owned by their canonical systems.
Chaos/Foam Influence is a source-backed environment context seam, not automatic activation of every anomaly described in Chaos/Foam source material.

Source-specific Chaos/Foam XP costs, die sizes, DCs, time ratios, exposure thresholds, mutation tables and perk mechanics remain source evidence for ENV-14 or their owning systems and are not generalized by ENV-13.

No Gehenna-specific overlay is invented because retained authority establishes Gehenna as a branch identity but does not establish a reusable Gehenna environmental condition in this tranche's source set.
All definitions are owner-authorized normalized content design; source_text_claimed remains false even when source_support records explain why a context seam exists.

overlays.name: Magical Saturation
overlays.applicability: Ambient magical influence is materially elevated relative to the local environment's ordinary baseline without changing the underlying terrain or setting identity.

deltas.value_or_reference: elevated ambient magical influence
magic-aware encounters or anomalies may become contextually more relevant; selection remains externally owned
ambient magical resonance may make magic-linked resources or phenomena contextually discoverable where source/local authority supports them

overlays.name: Magical Dead Zone
overlays.applicability: Ambient magical influence is materially suppressed, absent, inaccessible, or locally disconnected relative to the environment's ordinary baseline; exact consequences remain owned by the relevant magic/ability systems.

deltas.value_or_reference: suppressed or absent ambient magical influence
magic-dependent environmental phenomena may be reduced or absent only where their owning rules make them dependent on ambient magic
ambient magical resonance is constrained; source/local exceptions remain visible

overlays.name: Reality Instability
overlays.applicability: Local spatial, causal, material, sensory, or rule-consistency cues are unstable relative to the governing reality's normal baseline, without assuming any specific distortion table or participant effect.

deltas.value_or_reference: local environmental consistency is unstable or fluctuating
ordinary spatial or environmental reference cues may be unreliable where local authority establishes a distortion
reality anomalies may be relevant to discovery/encounter composition without being automatically generated

relations.scope: only while both overlays are already active in materially overlapping scopes
only while both overlays are already active in materially overlapping scopes

overlays.name: Dimensional Bleed
overlays.applicability: Properties, signals, matter, influence, or phenomena from another reality/dimension materially overlap or intrude into the local environment without requiring an open traversable portal.

deltas.value_or_reference: cross-reality boundary overlap is environmentally present
foreign environmental properties may be locally relevant only when explicitly supplied by World/Reality/local authority
cross-reality phenomena or inhabitants may become contextually eligible subject to canonical distribution and visibility

relations.scope: only while both overlays are already active in materially overlapping scopes
combined expression is resolved only when both are active; neither condition is created by the other

overlays.name: Portal Activity
overlays.applicability: One or more portals, gates, foldpoints, breaches, or comparable traversable/nontraversable inter-reality interfaces are active, recurrent, or environmentally significant in the scoped area.

deltas.value_or_reference: portal/gate/foldpoint activity is environmentally significant in scope
portal-linked route opportunities or hazards may exist; endpoint, permissions, reliability, and traversal rules remain externally owned
portal-linked arrivals/departures may be contextually relevant without automatically creating an encounter

relations.scope: combined expression is resolved only when both are active; portal activity does not create bleed and bleed does not create a portal

overlays.name: Psychic Influence
overlays.applicability: The environment carries materially significant psychic, emotional, memory, telepathic, or psionic influence independent of any single participant's condition.

deltas.value_or_reference: ambient psychic/mental influence is environmentally present
perception, memory, emotion, or thought may carry environmental psychic signals where participant-owning rules recognize them
psychic phenomena or psychic-sensitive entities may be contextually relevant subject to external distribution/visibility rules

relations.scope: combined expression is resolved only when both are already active

overlays.name: Corruption
overlays.applicability: A persistent or episodic supernatural influence marks, taints, transforms, degrades, or pressures environmental matter/places in a way that is not adequately represented as ordinary contamination; participant consequences remain externally owned.

deltas.value_or_reference: supernatural corruptive influence is environmentally present
resources or sites may carry corruptive context where source/local authority establishes it
corruption-linked phenomena may be contextually relevant without automatically altering creatures or participants

overlays.name: Temporal Instability
overlays.applicability: Local timeflow, temporal ordering, synchronization, recurrence, or duration references are unstable relative to the governing reality's ordinary baseline; no universal conversion ratio is implied.

deltas.value_or_reference: local temporal flow/order/synchronization is unstable or anomalous
routes, schedules, or returns may require temporal context supplied by the owning World/Reality/runtime rules
temporal anomalies may be relevant without automatically producing loops, aging changes, or time travel

relations.scope: combined expression is resolved only when both are already active

overlays.name: Chaos/Foam Influence
overlays.applicability: The scoped environment is within the Chaos or Foam, or is materially affected by source-established Chaos/Foam influence. This is a specific Multiversal context, not a synonym for generic reality, temporal, psychic, corruption, gravity, or dimensional conditions.

deltas.value_or_reference: Chaos/Foam environmental context is active in scope
source-supported recursive/inverted/shifting spatial context may be relevant where locally present; exact checks and formulas are not generalized
source-supported remnants, residual energy, mutagrowths, or salvage may be contextually discoverable where local/source authority establishes them; quantities are not inferred
Chaos/Foam-native anomalies, entities, or remnants may be contextually eligible subject to canonical distribution/visibility

references.support: A named Chaos and Foam Environment Perk Tree contains eight published environment-dependent perks keyed to being in the Chaos or Foam, including resonance, spatial recursion, memory/identity, displacement/time-loop, foraging/salvage and shifting-geometry contexts.

Source describes Foam/Chaos as dead-reality remnants with inverted/recursive geometry, anomalous gravity/light/time, memory/echo phenomena, remnants/resources and explicit source-specific travel/exposure/adaptation mechanics.
Recovered source-index rows preserve the tree record plus eight published member perks and their page provenance.

overlays.name: Dream Influence
overlays.applicability: Dream, oneiric, subconscious, symbolic, or sleep-adjacent logic materially influences the local environment without presuming that occupants are asleep or that imagined content automatically becomes real.

deltas.value_or_reference: dream/oneiric environmental influence is present
dream-linked psychic/symbolic signals may be environmentally present where owning systems recognize them
perception/memory symbolism may be environmentally relevant without forcing hallucination or sleep
dream-linked phenomena may be contextually relevant without automatic manifestation

relations.scope: only while both overlays are already active in materially overlapping scopes
